lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting Saturday 2026-09-12.
You cook on Sunday: the plan sets its sessions on those days, and nowhere else.
This window is short: 1 cooking session, no more — two on the same day would only be one.
The plan starts on Saturday, a day earlier: that is the cooking day, and nothing is eaten on it.
Everything is cooked on Saturday, in one go: whatever would not keep in the fridge until the meal goes in the freezer.
One shop, on Saturday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The shared base is vegetarian: that is Maya's line, and they have their own box. The rest of the table keeps theirs.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.
Everyone has every one of their meals.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.
The shared meals use vegetarian proteins throughout, so everyone can eat from the same carefully prepared base while the plates remain varied.

dishes.name: Golden potato breakfast
dishes.title: Potato hash, berries and breakfast protein
dishes.method: Reheat the shared hash and prepare the shared box first on clean equipment. Close it, wash the board, knife, pan and worktop, use fresh oil and a separate spoon, then assemble the yoghurt or omelette box with the berries.
dishes.why: A warm potato breakfast with fresh British berries makes the first meal substantial and seasonal.

dishes.name: Apple oat breakfast
dishes.title: Baked oats, yoghurt and apple
dishes.method: After the shared box is closed, take one baked oat portion from the clean container, spoon over the yoghurt and add the blueberries.
dishes.why: The baked oats are comforting, portable and made more substantial with yoghurt and fresh fruit.

dishes.name: Barley harvest bowl
dishes.title: Pearl barley, roasted vegetables and protein box
dishes.method: Reheat the shared barley and prepare its shared protein boxes first on clean equipment. Close the boxes, wash the board, knife, pan and worktop, use fresh oil and a separate spoon, then finish with yoghurt, lemon and parsley.
dishes.why: Pearl barley and roasted September vegetables make a hearty lunch that travels and reheats well.

dishes.name: Herby lentil pitta
dishes.title: Lentil patties, wholemeal pitta and salad
dishes.method: After the shared boxes are closed, warm the lentil patties, split the pitta and fill it with the patties, lettuce and yoghurt.
dishes.why: A crisp pitta turns the lentil batch into a filling lunch with a different texture from the shared bowl.

dishes.name: Curry rice supper
dishes.title: Coconut rice, roasted vegetables and protein box
dishes.method: Reheat the shared curry and prepare its shared protein boxes first on clean equipment. Close them, wash the board, knife, pan and worktop, use fresh oil and a separate spoon, then add yoghurt, lemon and coriander.
dishes.why: Coconut rice and roasted vegetables give Sunday dinner a rich, warming finish without complicated day-of work.

dishes.name: Polenta morning bake

dishes.why: Baked polenta makes a savoury breakfast that is different from Sunday while still being ready in minutes.

dishes.name: Warm apple oat square

dishes.method: After the shared box is closed, warm the oat square, top it with yoghurt and sliced apple, and dust with cinnamon.
dishes.why: A different topping and serving style keeps the small breakfast batch enjoyable on its second morning.

dishes.name: Tomato pasta harvest
dishes.title: Wholemeal pasta, courgettes and protein box
dishes.method: Reheat the pasta and prepare its shared protein boxes first on clean equipment. Close the boxes, wash the board, knife, pan and worktop, use fresh oil and a separate spoon, then add yoghurt, lemon and basil.
dishes.why: Wholemeal pasta and late-summer courgettes make a familiar lunch with a fresh tomato base.

dishes.name: Lentil pasta pitta
dishes.title: Lentil patties, wholemeal wrap and tomato
dishes.method: After the shared boxes are closed, warm the lentil patties, crumble them into the wrap and add tomato and yoghurt.
dishes.why: Crumbling the patties into a wrap gives the second lunch a fresh, quick texture rather than repeating the first plate.

dishes.name: Golden couscous supper
dishes.title: Couscous, roasted vegetables and protein box
dishes.method: Reheat the shared couscous and prepare its shared protein boxes first on clean equipment. Close them, wash the board, knife, pan and worktop, use fresh oil and a separate spoon, then add yoghurt, lemon and mint.
dishes.why: Couscous, carrots and courgettes make a colourful Monday dinner that is distinct from the curry.

dishes.name: Minted tofu pitta
dishes.title: Roasted tofu, vegetables and wholemeal pitta
dishes.method: After the shared boxes are closed, warm the tofu and vegetables, fill the pitta and add yoghurt and lemon.
dishes.why: A pitta and bright lemon yoghurt turn the tofu batch into a lighter-feeling but complete final dinner.

dishes.name: Jules' feta toast
dishes.title: Wholemeal toast with feta and olive oil
dishes.method: Toast the bread, crumble over feta and add olive oil. Prepare and close this small side dish first on clean equipment, then wash the board and knife before handling the shared breakfast.
dishes.why: A compact toast side adds energy and cheese to the shared breakfast.

dishes.title: Wholemeal toast with cheddar and olive oil
dishes.method: Toast the bread, add cheddar and olive oil, and close the box. Prepare and close this side dish first on clean equipment, then wash the board and knife before handling the shared lunch.
dishes.why: Cheddar, bread and olive oil make a small, dense accompaniment to lunch.

dishes.name: Theo's cheese toast
dishes.title: Wholemeal toast with cheddar and olive oil

dishes.why: This small cheesy toast adds a rich, simple extra to the lentil pasta.

dishes.name: Jules' curry toast
dishes.title: Wholemeal toast with feta and olive oil
dishes.method: Toast the bread, add feta and olive oil, and close the box. Prepare and close this side dish first on clean equipment, then wash the board and knife before handling the shared dinner.
dishes.why: Feta toast is a quick, rich side for the tofu curry.

preparations.title: Roasted potato breakfast hash
preparations.method: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the diced potatoes with the oil and paprika, roast until browned, then fold through wilted spinach and chopped tomatoes before cooling into four containers.

preparations.title: Barley and roasted vegetable base
preparations.method: Boil the barley until tender and drain well. Roast the aubergine, peppers and onion with the oil, stir in the passata and fold through the barley and crumbled feta before cooling.

preparations.title: Coconut rice and roasted curry vegetables
preparations.method: Cook the rice separately and cool it quickly. Roast the sweet potato and cauliflower in oil, soften the onion, then simmer the passata, coconut milk and curry powder before combining with the vegetables and boxing the rice alongside.

preparations.title: Baked mushroom polenta
preparations.method: Cook the polenta in the milk until thick. Sauté the mushrooms and spinach in the oil, fold them with half the cheese into the polenta, spread in a tray, top with the remaining cheese and bake until firm.

preparations.title: Tomato courgette pasta base
preparations.method: Boil the pasta just short of tender and drain. Sauté the courgettes in the oil, add the peas and passata, simmer briefly, then fold through the pasta and cheese before cooling.

preparations.title: Roasted vegetable couscous
preparations.method: Roast the carrots and courgettes with the oil. Pour the hot vegetable stock over the couscous, cover until tender, fluff thoroughly and fold through the vegetables and feta.

preparations.title: Herb egg omelette
preparations.method: Wilt the spinach in the oil, whisk the eggs with the chives, cook the mixture gently in a lined roasting tin and finish in the oven. Cool completely and cut into six portions.

preparations.title: Paprika roast chicken
preparations.method: Coat the chicken with oil, lemon and paprika. Roast on a clean tray until fully cooked, rest, slice and cool before boxing six portions.

preparations.title: Herb turkey meatballs
preparations.method: Mix the turkey with finely chopped onion, oats and parsley, shape into meatballs and roast on a lined tray until cooked through. Cool and divide into six portions.

preparations.title: Crisp lentil patties
preparations.method: Simmer the lentils until just tender and drain thoroughly. Mix with egg, oats and finely chopped onion, shape into patties, brush with oil and roast until firm and browned. Cool four portions.

preparations.title: Roasted tofu and vegetables
preparations.method: Press and cube the tofu. Toss it with the broccoli, peppers, oil and soy sauce, roast until the tofu is browned and the vegetables are tender, then cool and divide into four portions.

preparations.title: Apple yoghurt oat bake
preparations.method: Mix the oats, diced apples, eggs, milk and yoghurt. Bake in a lined dish until set and golden, cool fully and cut into two portions.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Heat the oven and start the barley, rice and lentils first. Roast the potato hash, chicken, turkey meatballs, tofu, lentil patties, polenta, pasta base, couscous vegetables and oat bake in overlapping trays, using clean trays and utensils for the shared components before starting the separate plate components. Cook and cool the shared bases and protein batches, then portion and close their boxes before washing boards, knives, pans and worktops and using fresh oil for the separate plate batches. Cool the rice quickly, refrigerate Sunday's and Monday's portions, and label every box; all ingredients bought on Saturday go straight into this session, with no later cooking or shop.
